## Synopsis

```text
perch outbound [OPTIONS] COMMAND
```

## Description

Inspect the outbound table populated by the submission relay. It shows acceptance and later delivery attempts reported by mxRaven.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--help, -h` | show help |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [perch outbound list](perch-outbound-list.md) | list submitted messages |

## Examples

```sh
perch outbound list --account you@example.com
```
